newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexlco's Telmex announces tariffs hikes from Jan 1.
newsitem.headline: Mexlco's Telmex announces tariffs hikes from Jan 1.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) said Saturday that the Federal Telecommunications Commission approved higher prices for long-distance calls and basic services from January 1.
Telmex said the single, daily national long-distance rate will be 1.99 peso per minute from next year. The company gave no comparative figures.

"This tariff is subject to additional commercial discounts for use that fluctuate between 20-29.54 percent, as well as discounts for night-time use, Sunday use and other traditional discounts," Telmex said in a statement.
